## Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Target Application

- [ ] Google Antigravity
- [ ] Claude
- [ ] ChatGPT
- [ ] Other (please specify):

## Environment Information

- OS: [e.g. Windows 11 23H2, Windows 10 22H2]
- PowerShell Version: [e.g. Windows PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7.4]
- SplitSpace Version / Commit: [e.g. main / commit hash]

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `.\install.ps1`
2. Open target application
3. Right-click taskbar icon and select secondary launch
4. See error or unexpected behavior

## Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually occurred (e.g. window failed to launch, icon mismatch, auth loop).

## Logs or Screenshots

If applicable, paste terminal output or attach screenshots to help explain the problem.
